description: Drafted blog post 'Cities That Win' framed around cities/communities winning economically by being business-friendly. David's intended angle was specifically about the contrast between career politicians (who have no grasp of business) vs. business people who serve in politics — not a post about economic development or city competitiveness.
correction: Post should be reframed around the two types of people who hold public office: those who came from business and understand the transaction, and career politicians who perform virtue instead of governing. Samsung and Bears are examples that illustrate the argument, not the subject of the post.
systemic_fix: When David's #content message includes a detailed POV (not just a URL), use his stated thesis as the frame rather than inferring a theme from the article headline.
